segments.text: Supervised agencies, colleagues in the Senate, Senator Aimee, magandang hapon po sa ating lahat.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: Today we will hear the proposed Fiscal Year 2027 budget of the Department of Social Welfare and Development. Sa budget hearing na ito, simple ang prinsipyo natin. Kapag may pamilyang nagugutom, nawawala ng trabaho o kabuhayan, nakakasakit o tinatamaan ng sakuna, dapat may gobyernong sasalo. I’m fully aware that the House-approved GAAB provides P262.757 billion in new appropriations for DSWD, higher than the NEP, although still below the 2026 GAA program level.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: We take note of the adjustments made by our colleagues in the House of Representatives. AICS increases to about 58.1 billion pesos. The Quick Response Fund is restored to 3 billion pesos. The Sustainable Livelihood Program increases to almost 6 billion pesos. But more money must mean better social protection.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: Una, we must protect 4Ps as a rights-based investment in poor families and their children. If families graduate from 4Ps, graduation must mean more than losing a grant. They should have a real pathway to education, skills, employment, livelihood, and continued access to basic services. Hindi graduation ang mawalan ng benepisyo.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: Pangalawa, we must protect our senior citizens.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: The social pension remains a lifeline for millions of indigent seniors, yet many qualified senior citizens remain on the waiting or remain waiting for assistance.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: At 1,000 pesos a month, we must also keep asking whether the benefit remains adequate given the rising cost of food, medicine, and transportation.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: Pangatlo, AICs must remain a genuine social safety net.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: Dapat nakabatay sa pangangailangan, hindi sa kung sino ang kakilala o kung sino ang nag-refer.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: We need stronger controls against duplicate payments, but digitization must not exclude people without bank accounts, without a phone, with poor connectivity, or with incomplete records.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: Pang-apat, we must also prepare for the Super El Niño and other climate shocks.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: The restoration of the QRF is important, but DSWD must be ready before families reach a crisis point with food assistance, emergency cash, cash for work, livelihood support, and coordination with LGUs.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: At the same time, we recognize DSWD's investment in disaster response and rehabilitation programs, such as Project Lawa at Binhi,

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: helping communities survive today's shocks while reducing their vulnerability to future disasters.

segments.text: So, that's why we also put it in our tier 2 na sana dagdagan ho beyond even that level.

segments.text: Kasi when I was a secretary, problema na ho talaga ito sa dami po ng kailangan sa mga regional offices po na ninyo.

segments.text: Actually, Madam Chair, during our tier 2, pinaabot ho namin yung request namin na karagdagang 3.5B para kukam na close to 10 billion.

segments.text: Madam Chair, the good senator knows this very well.

segments.text: Itong programa na ito, nakakatulong ito in the long run.

segments.text: Kasi halimbawa yung umaalis sa 4Bs, doon natin pinapasok para hindi nababalik sa kahirapan.

segments.text: And it's teaching them how to fish.

segments.text: Because parang grant po ito kasi, Madam Chair, itong SLP.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Well, anyway, moving to another topic.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Ito, medyo sensitive po ito at saka napapanahon.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Ni SP, tinaasan po namin when he was the Finance Chair, yung inyo pong Assistance for Individuals in Crisis.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Wala pa pong mga sakuna, kung ano man po yan, dilubyo.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Pero we anticipated na baka may mangyari kasi medyo nagkakagirian na po yung Amerika at Iran.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Tama nga po yung naging desisyon na dagdagan po kayo.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Umabot po tayo ng 63 something billion.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Ang presidente, kayong unang inilagay sa front line to address the problems.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Pwede po ba ng mga ating mga transport, pambilin ng mga gasolina, yung mga OFWs natin, tumulong din po kayo.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: So talagang malaki po na gastos po ninyo doon.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Pero nagtataka lang po ako, binawasan po sa NEP ninyo.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Pero dinagdagan naman na umabot na po sa 30 something billion.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Tapos ito pong gyera sa Iran, di pa po tapos.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Hindi natin alam kung hanggang kailan po ito.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Pati nga po yung Yemen, Somalia, Saudi Arabia, mga Houthis.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Kung saan saan na ho nag-ikang umugat itong problema nito.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Yung El Nino, tapos hindi pa po natin alam kung ano talagang epekto nito.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Is it enough na dinagdagan po sa gab?

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: gusto kong magpasalamat kay Senator Erwin,

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: kay Senator Sherwin dahil binalik ko yan na dinagdagan.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Yung dinagdag ho naging standby fund natin.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Nung kasagsagan nito, at hindi ko naman pwede sabihin natapos na,

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: close to 10 billion in one month ang ginamit natin para sa mga transport workers natin.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: In fact, nagpa-quick survey ho ang SWS tulad na nabanggit ko kanina.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: 96% of the respondents doon sa catchment said,

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: ginamit nila yung pera para magpatuloy ng hanap buhay.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: 80% naman ang sinabi, ginamit nila yun para makabili ng pagkain nung nangangailangan sila.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: So, ngayon nangangamba ho kami sa pagbawas na meron nga triple whammy na ina-anticipate,

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Kaya nga ho, maraming salamat sa tanong na dumudulog kami ngayon ulit

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: sa Komitee at sa Senado na sana ibalik man lang doon sa level ng GAAP last year.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Kahit ngayon, very tight na eh.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Pero kung talagang tight fiscal space, maibalik man lang doon.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Palagay ko, mas kakayanin natin ng konti po.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Will that sustain isa ka sakali?

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: I mean, ang pinag-usapan lang kasi natin, in-anticipate natin po yung El Niño.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Pero paano kung may mga darating pa ng mga dilubyok at baka magkakaroon pa po ng gera,

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Will that be sufficient na ikanga para, kasi kayo po laging pag may mga ganito sitwasyon,

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: DSWD, nandoon ho kayo sa front line.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: May problema po ang mga magsasakan natin, DSWD, natulong din po.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Mangingis na, DSWD pa rin ho.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: So, ano ho, what is your take on this?

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Sabi ko ho ito sa House, nung pinatawag ho kami during the budget season,

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Nangangamba kami na yung natira na,

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: eh maaaring hindi sasapat, kaya dumudulog ho kami na sana ibalik man lang,

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: man lang, to the minimum sa gaal level.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Madam Chair, tama ho kayo na kulang kung titignan.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Pero gusto ko rin ho i-assure yung committee na kung mabalik ho yun,

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: kaya naman namin i-balance siya with the quick response.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Kasi kanina nabanggit na rin ho yung quick response.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Dahil the quick response, kami ho ang pinaka, DSWD po ang pinakamalaking user po noon.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: So, pinagsasabay ho namin gamitin yan.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Pero admittedly, kahit tignan nyo yung quick response,

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: by this time, medyo konti na rin ho yung balance ng Ndream Fund.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Now, Madam Chair, there was a year na binibigyan kami ng Office of,

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: but binibigyan kami rin ng contingency fund galing sa Office of the President to augment.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Pero alam ko po yung sinasabi nyo na paano pag hindi kayo bigyan,

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: And kung pwede ho, dagdagan pa beyond the gaal level because of the anticipated,

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Yung El Nino na not just the farmers, but the prices of goods and food actually,

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: And then, meron pa ho yung sunod-sunod na mga regular ho na mga pangangailangan,

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Yung QRF ho na nabanggit ho ninyo last year,

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: nung nagkagulo na nga po, nagkagero na nga.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: I called my good friend, Yuseca Dayan Cahipe.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Pero kailangan lang i-juggle siguro yung Secretary Rex Gatchal yan.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Kumusta naman po itong QRF ninyo?

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Hindi naman natin ikang pinagdarasal na sana dumating lahat itong problema.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Pero will that be sufficient po itong QRF?

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Una po, nagpapasalamatin kami sa inyo.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Dahil yung standby fund na seed capital ng QRF, nilakihan ho nyo last time.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Umabot na ho ng 3 billion yun.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Crucial ho kasi yun dahil yung replenishment mechanism takes around,

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: So in that 2 weeks time, maraming pwedeng mangyari.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Pero kaya nga ho, natuwa kami na sa house, ibinalik sa 3 billion.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Kasi that gives us the leg room na yung term nyo, mabalans eh.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: So habang humihingi kami ng replenishment, tuloy-tuloy pa rin activity sa baba

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: sa pagbayad ng emergency cash transfer.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Pero kung tatanungin niyo ako kung kasha,

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: if you look at the balance ng Ndream Fund right now,

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: ang natitira na lang ho na balance ng Ndream Fund is 900 million.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Kasi hindi lang ho kami ang gumagamit noon.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Pero there was a prior year, huwag ho tayo not to raise the worry of anybody.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Meron rin hong year na replenish ho yan ng Office of the President using their contingency fund.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: So meron ho siyang back-to-back na alam naman ho ng Office of the President

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: na pag mababa na yun, ginalagyan rin ho nila ng pera.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: I think I've also experienced that, Secretary, when I was a Secretary of DSW,

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: nagsunod-sunod na po, may earthquake po sa Abra

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: and then may landslide po sa...

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: I am very aware na yung pondo na yan, pinabibili po ng mga food packs,

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: sobrang dami pagkatapos yung mga, syempre, materials sa mga bahay.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: So yun lang ho yung concern natin.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: What if, hindi pa natin alam, hindi pa natin ma-estimate itong damage na gagawin po ng ilin ninyo na ito.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Pero will you agree with me, mas maganda siguro na prepared ho tayo na meron tayong pera,

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: sa bulsa, na ipamimigay, itutulog sa mga kababayan natin.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Because, who never know, hindi lang naman magsasaka maapektuhan dito.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Pati siguro yung mga fisher folks natin, pati po yung ordinary yung tao, di po ba,

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: na kailangan may mga pampagamot, di ba, kaya sa sobrang init.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: So kaya kailangan siguro natin na tag-aralan at dagdagan mo siguro.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: So how much are we looking at dito sa, yung sabi nyo kanina, sa AX, kahit na kung hindi abot mo ng 63, mga nasa 50.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Sa QRF, ilan ho ang dapat?

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Yung ikang napupwede para hindi ho tayo nangangamba, hindi ka nangangamba.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Madam Chair, yung balikan ko lang yung AX ho, since nabalik ho ulit, sana mabalik man lang sa 63.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: That's our minimum sana. Huwag na ho bababa sana doon.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Kasi as it is right now, nauubos ho yun.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Now, dito lang sa Quick Response Fund.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Just to give you an idea, kanina na-flash naman ho namin, naka 13.6 billion na ho ang DSWD alone.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Tama yung mga ibang ahensya na kumukuha ho doon.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: So tama ho kayo, sana matignan rin ho yun kung paano siya i-beef up.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Kasi from my understanding, it is a percentage of the, mayroon siyang fixed formula po siya.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: So I think we will be restrained by the N-DREAM law kung paano siya ilalakihan.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Pero kung mabibisita po, much better.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Finally po, isa na lamang nga talaga, Madam Chair.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Yun pong pondo po, kasama na po ba dito sa OSEC ito, yung para sa pagpapagawa ninyo sana,

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: na you were discussing with me, ng home for the elderly sa Visayas region, Secretary?

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: That's a very, very good idea po for our cities.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Kasi dito sa Metro Manila, meron po tayo, diba, yung Golden Acres.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Sa Visayas po, kayo nakaisip noon na gusto rin yun.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Ang lagyan para yung mga na-abandon na na, na mga matatanda, meron silang shelter sa Visayas.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Nakasama na po ba ito sa OSEC budget na inaprubahan din po ng, dumaan na rin sa GAB?

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Unfortunately, hindi ho nakasama dahil karamihan ho ng budget na nasa OSEC are grants.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Yan ho marami ho dyan are grants. Wala halos na capital expenditure.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Ang request nga ho namin is to construct itong home for the aged.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Pangalawa, to also repair yung mga existing.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: That's why we're lobbying again and it's part of our submission na sana mapigyan ho ng atensyon when the period of amendments comes into play.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Hindi po napasama ito sa capital outlay ninyo for 2027?

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Wala ho, hindi ho siya na take up.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Well, anyway, Madam Chair, I really do support.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: And kung ako pong tatanungin nyo as a DSWD Secretary, sakit po talaga sa ulo pag may mga dilubyo.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Kinakabahan po ang Secretary dahil una pong tinatawagan ka agad ng Pangulo ang kalihim po ng DSWD na tinatanong kung kumusta.

segments.text: So early in the morning, 4 o'clock, 5 o'clock, sumatawag na po ang Malacanang at kinukumusta.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Anyway, I know the feeling as Secretary.

segments.text: But Madam Chair, and then hopefully sa plenary, we can add yung mga wish list po nila.

segments.text: Ito po, when I got to the department, and alam ko nire-reform rin ito ni Sen. Erwin noon, hindi lang yan natapos.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: We have a line item called the Disaster Resilience Response Rehabilitation Program, DRRP.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: That's a 1.1 billion expenditure in our books.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Now, nung nadatna namin yan, that's a cash-for-work program na yung work program was very loose

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: in the sense na iba-iba yung pinagagawa sa kanila.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: we consulted with the Department of Agriculture, World Food Program,

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: and we revamped it as early as 2023,

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: na isa, dalawa lang ang ginagawa nila,

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: It's called LAWA, which are sweeps yun,

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: So, we asked the A, where are the springs?

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Kasi doon namin nilalagay yung mga sweeps natin.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: And then they would also plant around it.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Now, right now, these are found in communities that were targeted initially by the Climate Change Commission,

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Noon pa, as drought, malapit sila sa drought, or any forms of climate change.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: So, these are the same communities that will be affected or are being affected already by El Nino.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: So, these sweeps or small water impounding systems na help them irrigate small community farms

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: and at the same time provide income because yung mga naaani nila dyan,

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: by the way, yung seeds at yung mga isda na linalagay dyan ay galing sa PA.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Binibenta nila yan either through feeding program, through the Walang Gutom, or they consume it themselves.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: So, somehow, yung panawagan ng DA na to do community gardens to ease prices ng pagkain is already underway.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: We, in fact, have 5,000 of these sweeps nationwide.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Pinaghandaan ho namin siya since 2023, kaya ganyan karami ho yan.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: And the Department of Agriculture is helping us by introducing drought-resilient crops,

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: both high-value and regular, katulad ng taro, kamote, and pag high-value, watermelon, okra.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: So, yan ho yung mga... yan yung partnership namin ng Department of Agriculture.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: So, when we say resilient, so kasi we didn't look at El Nino just now,

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: but we were looking at El Nino way back in 2023, or La Nina as a matter of fact.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: small water impounding systems or projects cannot be built in a span of couple of months.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: That this was done way, way back.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Now, that's the first one in terms of social development.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: By the way, baka matanong nyo anong connection namin doon?

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Yung cash for work nila, for 20 days, they do the sweeps lang.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: And then, kung ano yung inani doon sa kanila na yun, and then napapaikot na nila by themselves.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: The second slide, obviously, yung bilanggit ni Sekiko kanina,

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Nag-start na ho kami ng emergency cash transfers in Cagayan, in Isabela, Camarines Norte, as we speak.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Now, we are monitoring it based on the declarations of state of calamity.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: And like Sekiko said, may close coordination kami, they will pass on to us areas of vulnerability.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Na tulad ng nangyari sa RSSI, they were the ones who told us which provinces to move into

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: based also on the state of calamity.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: For our social development, natatanong ho ito lagi sa akin, yung community-driven development o yung kalahi.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Remember, kalahi, naubos na ho yung ODA niyan when we joined the department in 2024.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: So, we applied for a new ODA that was approved, and you can see it in the unprogrammed also at my line item yan.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Basically, the community-driven development was converted into community-driven development

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: looking at disaster resilience to include droughts.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: So, one particular project that already opened and we're expanding it will be...

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Now, this community, for instance, in Masbate, nasa isla yan, I've been there, wala talagang tubig sila.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: So, this system is supposed to help them in the wash, to come up with sanitary water para sa mga community nila

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: kasi right now, they have to go to the town proper and spend so much money to get just a liter of water.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: And right now, it's coming in handy during the El Nino.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: So, our approach, Madam Chairman, is both social development and social protection.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Yung ECT as a means of bridging them para hindi ho sila mahulog palalim sa kahirapan.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: When we look at AICs or emergency cash transfer, hindi naman siya the ends to the means.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: So, sana gagamitin namin yun para maitawid sila, yung mga magsasaka o yung mga mangingisda na maapektuhan during the next six months.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Pero at the same time, we're embarking on social development programs that are meant for the long term.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Katulad ng Project Lawat Binhi at netong air-to-water system ng community-driven development.

segments.text: But 2027, in other words, is only 4.6.

segments.text: So, hindi siya responsive to the situation in the next 6 to 12 months.

segments.text: Mabuti kung walang El Nino, di ba?
